findings.description: This bucket defines no server_side_encryption_configuration and no default-encryption enforcement, so every object (starting with the seeded vendor roster) is stored using S3's default unencrypted at-rest state. Data written here is not protected against storage-layer or media disclosure.

The ledger export bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so financial ledger exports are persisted unencrypted at rest with no KMS key or AES-256 default applied. This is a control failure for regulated financial data.

Versioning and access logging are enabled but there is no server_side_encryption_configuration, so model artifacts are stored unencrypted at rest. Versioning retains every historical unencrypted copy, widening the exposure window.
This bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so operational runbooks are stored unencrypted. Runbooks frequently contain internal operational detail that should be encrypted at rest.

This object upload specifies no server_side_encryption, and its target bucket (reports_archive) has no default encryption, so the vendor roster is written unencrypted at rest. Because the object relies on bucket defaults that are absent, the sensitive spreadsheet content is unprotected.
